name: SOVIO
description: The Sound of Mountains & Mist - Vintage Pahadi radio and mountain studio with auto Mood Scheduler (local time circadian lighting and genre match), synchronized lyrics & sing-along karaoke, multi-singer playlists (Arijit Singh, Mohit Chauhan, Jubin Nautiyal, KK, Shreya Ghoshal, Kishore Kumar, Pahadi folk), ambient soundscapes mixer, and HRTC bus memories.
